thread:
maria (AE): quick sync — acme wants a 2-week POC to validate: 1) classification+extraction for invoices, 2) reliable low-hallucination answers for policy Qs, 3) 75% cost reduction vs current infra. need to lock success metrics, baseline prompts, and security asks. can we list owners and asap timeline?

jonas (SE): ok. i can draft baseline prompts + eval harness. need sample input shapes (pdfs vs text) and expected outputs (fields + confidence). also want to confirm latency SLO — is 300ms p50 acceptable?

maria (AE): input will be OCR->text. customer expects structured fields: vendor, total, tax, line_items[]. they want near-real-time for UI (p50 ~ 400ms ok if documented).

eli (ML Eng): noted. for POC i recommend: baseline model = redwood/opt-xxl-quant (dev), fallback to smaller quantized for cost. baseline prompt set (first pass):
```
System: You are an accurate extractor. Output only JSON with keys: vendor, total, tax, items (array of {desc,qty,price}). Include confidence 0-1 for each field.
User: <OCR_TEXT>
```
small sample prompt variations: ask-for-currency, ask-for-line-splitting, strict-json mode.

maria (AE): can you also add a few safety guardrails for customer-facing answers? they want low hallucination on policy replies.

eli (ML Eng): for policy Qs we'll use a closed-book retrieval + rerank. baseline prompt for QA:
```
System: Use only the provided knowledge snippets. If answer not found, respond "No relevant info found." Keep answer <= 150 chars.
User: <policy_question>
```
works well for evals.

tom (Pricing): pricing note — POC discounted: hosted credits covering up to 100k tokens per day for 2 weeks. if they need dedicated reserved capacity during POC we'll price separately (estimate based on 4x concurrent sessions). need SE to confirm expected concurrent sessions and per-request token counts.

jonas (SE): for invoicing flows estimate avg tokens: 400 input, 150 output => ~550 per request. expected concurrency ~10 during demo spikes. tagging for batching opportunities.

linda (Security): security checklist from customer: KMS for keying, VPC peering for private control plane, audit logs retention 90 days, data retention policy (delete after 30 days unless opt-in). for POC we can offer customer-managed KMS? depends on contract level. also need to complete their short questionnaire — i can fill if you drop answers.

maria (AE): i'll send questionnaire. linda — can you propose minimal security posture for POC that legal will accept?

linda (Security): minimal POC posture: TLS in transit, role-based access for team, KMS for logs, redact PII by default in demo logs, opt-out retention. i'll draft a one-pager by EOD.

sarah (CSM): deliverables + owners i propose: 1) prompt inventory + sample prompts (jonas, eli) — due in 48h, 2) eval harness + acceptance metrics (eli) — due in 72h, 3) security one-pager + questionnaire answers (linda) — EOD, 4) pricing/credits confirmation (tom) — 24h, 5) customer kickoff + timeline (maria + sarah) — schedule this week.

jonas (SE): sounds good. i'll upload a csv of ~30 starter prompts covering edge cases (dates, multi-currency, damaged receipts) and include expected JSON outputs. also adding a quick eval script snippet:
```
python eval.py --prompts prompts.csv --model redwood/opt-xxl-quant --metric exact_match,field_confidence,hallucination_rate
```

eli (ML Eng): for pass/fail thresholds recommend: field exact_match >= 92% on key fields (vendor/total), hallucination_rate < 3% on policy QA, median inference cost per request <= $0.02 (hosted estimate). if we hit these we're green.

maria (AE): customer also asked about SLA during pilot — they want a plan if model degrades. can we offer automated fallback to a simpler rule-based extractor?

jonas (SE): yes — implement a deterministic fallback (regex + heuristics) for critical fields (total, tax) with a confidence threshold. we'll surface fallback in response metadata.

tom (Pricing): confirmed credits. i'll send a short note with expected billing delta if they extend beyond POC.

linda (Security): quick Q: do we allow customer upload of real invoices for POC? if yes we need DPA addendum and scoping for storage. recommend synthetic dataset for initial eval then gated real uploads.

maria (AE): we'll propose synthetic for week1 and limited real uploads week2 pending DPA sign.

sarah (CSM): action items recap: jonas -> prompt csv + sample outputs (48h), eli -> eval harness + threshold config (72h), linda -> security one-pager + questionnaire answers (EOD), tom -> credits + billing note (24h), maria/sarah -> set kickoff with customer (this week). tagging owners in thread.

jonas (SE): ack. i'll also push a small demo notebook and a few example responses to the shared drive. :thumbsup:

eli (ML Eng): ack, i'll begin wiring the eval CI and add metrics dashboard hooks (latency/cost/quality).

linda (Security): ack, will add required language for DPA and KMS options.

maria (AE): thanks team — i'll update customer after we have the prompt CSV and the security one-pager. meeting tentatively thursday 10am PT.

sarah (CSM): added to calendar. closing thread after deliverables posted. :rocket:
